purpose: Give something the impression of an excessive or odd quality.
keywords: N + じみた / じみている
I was shocked by the absurdly high price.
I want to realize the plan, however fanciful it seems.
formation: N + じみた / じみている
restrictions: Common with 子供, 冗談, and 夢.
mistake: じみた modifies a noun; do not treat it as a standalone noun.
